title: Slope & Linear Equations (8.AF.6 Supplement)
preview: A supplemental unit addressing Indiana standard 8.AF.6: slope and y-intercept, writing linear equations from a graph, table, or description, interpreting them in context, and graphing from slope-intercept form.
description: This supplemental unit (no unit number of its own) targets Indiana standard 8.AF.6. Students find slope and y-intercept, generate linear equations from graphs, tables, and verbal descriptions, interpret slope and intercept in real contexts, and graph lines from slope-intercept form.

sections.label: Slope & Y-Intercept
sections.description: Find and interpret the slope and y-intercept of a linear relationship.

sections.label: Write Linear Equations (Graph, Table, or Description)
sections.description: Generate a linear equation given a graph, a table, or a verbal description.

sections.label: Interpret Slope & Y-Intercept in Context
sections.description: Given an equation in slope-intercept form, interpret the slope and y-intercept in a real situation.

sections.label: Graph from Slope-Intercept Form
sections.description: Graph a line on a coordinate grid given its equation in slope-intercept form.
